speaker: Mia
text: Welcome to our veggie shop, Max!

speaker: Max
text: Do vegetables accept credit cards?

speaker: Mia
text: Only if you lettuce pay!

speaker: Max
text: Ha! That joke still has roots.

speaker: Mia
text: These juicy red tomatoes are delicious.

speaker: Max
text: Wait, are tomatoes actually fruits?

speaker: Mia
text: Botanically yes; cooks use them as vegetables.

speaker: Max
text: Double agents in the salad!

speaker: Mia
text: Carrots are orange, crunchy roots.

speaker: Max
text: Do carrots give rabbits night vision?

speaker: Mia
text: Their vitamin A supports healthy eyesight.

speaker: Max
text: Then why the bunny sunglasses?

speaker: Mia
text: Here are potatoes: bake, mash, or roast!

speaker: Max
text: My potato feels mashed today.

speaker: Mia
text: That is one starchy joke, Max!

speaker: Max
text: I practise every fry-day!

speaker: Mia
text: Onions have layers and a strong smell.

speaker: Max
text: I chopped one. My eyes went swimming!

speaker: Mia
text: Cucumbers are crisp and cool.

speaker: Max
text: I told one to chill. Already cool!

speaker: Mia
text: Broccoli looks like tiny green trees.

speaker: Max
text: Where do the broccoli squirrels live?

speaker: Mia
text: By our fresh, leafy green spinach!

speaker: Max
text: Will spinach make me a superhero?

speaker: Mia
text: It has nutrients, but practise helps too.

speaker: Max
text: Aw! No instant superhero powers?

speaker: Mia
text: Bell peppers come in bright colors.

speaker: Max
text: Do bell peppers actually ring? Hello?

speaker: Mia
text: Nope! But they taste sweet and crunchy.

speaker: Max
text: Fine! I will answer with a carrot!

speaker: Mia
text: Eggplants are purple. Also called aubergines.

speaker: Max
text: Aubergine sounds like a royal vegetable!

speaker: Mia
text: This huge pumpkin makes tasty soup.

speaker: Max
text: Or a carriage for a hungry princess!

speaker: Mia
text: Look: peas, corn, and cauliflower!

speaker: Max
text: Peas be kind! Cauliflower has cloud hair!

speaker: Mia
text: Review: tomato, carrot, potato, onion, cucumber.

speaker: Max
text: Broccoli, spinach, pepper, eggplant, pumpkin!

speaker: Mia
text: And peas, corn, cauliflower. Your favorite?

speaker: Max
text: All of them! Can veggies join my comedy club?

speaker: Mia
text: Yes, but keep the jokes fresh!

speaker: Max
text: Thanks for shopping! Stay crunchy and smiling!

speaker: Mia
text: See you next time! Bye!

speaker: Max
text: Bye! And lettuce go home!
